description: CIS Benchmark controls bundled for CloudSentry. Mapped from CIS AWS/Azure/GCP Foundations Benchmarks.

controls.name: Ensure no root access key exists
controls.description: The root account should not have access keys. Root API access keys provide unrestricted access to all AWS services.

controls.name: Ensure MFA is enabled for root account
controls.description: The root account should have multi-factor authentication enabled to add an extra layer of protection.

controls.name: Ensure multi-factor authentication is enabled for IAM users with console access
controls.description: All IAM users with console passwords should have MFA enabled.

controls.name: Ensure IAM policies with full administrative privileges are not attached
controls.description: IAM policies should not allow full administrative privileges. Use least-privilege access.

controls.name: Ensure S3 bucket access logging is enabled
controls.description: S3 buckets should have server access logging enabled to track requests for security analysis.

controls.name: Ensure S3 bucket policy denies HTTP requests
controls.description: S3 bucket policies should enforce HTTPS-only access to protect data in transit.

controls.name: Ensure EBS volume encryption is enabled by default
controls.description: EBS volumes should have encryption enabled by default in the region settings.

controls.name: Ensure RDS instance encryption is enabled
controls.description: RDS database instances should have storage encryption enabled at rest.

controls.name: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
controls.description: AWS CloudTrail should be configured to log API activity in all regions.

controls.name: Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
controls.description: CloudTrail log file validation should be enabled to detect tampering or unauthorized modifications.

controls.name: Ensure no security group allows ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22
controls.description: Security groups should not allow unrestricted inbound SSH access from any IP address.

controls.name: Ensure no security group allows ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 3389
controls.description: Security groups should not allow unrestricted inbound RDP access from any IP address.

controls.name: Ensure that Storage Account access is restricted to HTTPS
controls.description: Azure Storage Accounts should enforce HTTPS-only access to data.

controls.name: Ensure public access level is disabled for Storage Accounts
controls.description: Blob containers should not allow anonymous public read access.

controls.name: Ensure that RDP access is restricted from the internet
controls.description: Network Security Groups should not allow unrestricted inbound RDP access (port 3389).

controls.name: Ensure default network does not exist in a project
controls.description: The default VPC network has pre-configured firewall rules that are overly permissive.

controls.name: Ensure Cloud Storage buckets are not anonymously accessible
controls.description: Cloud Storage buckets should not grant allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers access.

controls.name: Ensure Cloud SQL database instances require SSL connections
controls.description: Cloud SQL instances should enforce SSL for all incoming connections.
